title: Why sign-ups fell after the redesign
caption: Dashed: investigated and ruled out. Bold: confirmed by the A/B rerun.

effect.text: Weekly sign-ups down 18 % since the new landing page

causes.text: Phone number became a required field
Password rules shown only after an error
Paid campaign paused the same week
Sign-up button below the fold on phones
Hero image adds 1.2 s to load
Tracking event renamed in the release
Pricing link removed from the header
